name: aidlc-ux
description: UI/UX pod for the AIDLC pipeline, on two design sources. When the screens already exist in Figma it implements them to the design via the Figma MCP and checks fidelity, jury optional. When they don't, it invents them: UX-narrative writer, Awwwards inspiration researcher, design-system owner (the uniformity anchor), motion/interaction specialist, and a strict unbiased jury that renders the UI and gates on a ≥9/10 score. New or existing projects, page or whole-app scope, honors supplied brand references (logo, colors, fonts).
